# Normal and abnormal parameters

*Generated by `analyze_data.py`.*

**How to read this.** "Rule" rows come from the specification and the EU air-quality limits, and they change the speed limit. "Data band" rows only describe what was typical in the January data (5th to 95th percentile). They do not change the speed limit, and they do not say what is safe.

Optimal conditions, where the limit stays at 80 km/h: at least 0.5 lux of light, no black-ice danger, PM10 at most 50 µg/m³ and NO₂ at most 200 µg/m³.

| Parameter | Unit | Allowed range | Normal | Abnormal | Basis | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Illuminance | lux | 0 to 1e+06 lux | at least 0.5 lux | below 0.5 lux (dark) | SPEC1 (500 millilux) | Rule: changes the limit |
| Water on road | µm | 0 to 10000 µm | at most 1000 µm, or any amount at 0 °C or warmer | above 1000 µm while below 0 °C (black ice) | SPEC2 | Rule: changes the limit |
| Temperature | °C | -30 to 70 °C | 0 °C or warmer, or colder with at most 1000 µm of water | below 0 °C with more than 1000 µm of water (black ice) | SPEC2 | Rule: changes the limit |
| Wind strength | km/h | 0 to 300 km/h | 0 to 75.2 km/h | below 0 or above 75.2 km/h | Data only (January); does not change the limit | Data band: informational only |
| Humidity | % | 0 to 100 % | 72 to 97 % | below 72 or above 97 % | Data only (January); does not change the limit | Data band: informational only |
| Traffic | cars/s | 0 to 50 cars/s | 3.5 to 29 cars/s | below 3.5 or above 29 cars/s | Data only (January); does not change the limit | Data band: informational only |
| PM10 | µg/m³ | 0 to 2000 µg/m³ | at most 50 µg/m³ | above 50 µg/m³ | EU daily limit, Directive 2008/50/EC | Rule: changes the limit |
| NO₂ | µg/m³ | 0 to 2000 µg/m³ | at most 200 µg/m³ | above 200 µg/m³ | EU hourly limit, Directive 2008/50/EC | Rule: changes the limit |

## Notes on units

- SPEC1 states darkness in millilux. The sensors and the GUI use lux: 500 millilux = 0.5 lux.
- The water and temperature rules only apply together. Water alone or frost alone is not black ice.
- `SensorTypes.csv` gives wind strength in `hm/h`. This is read as a typo for km/h.
- `SensorTypes.csv` gives air pressure in `mmHG` with a range of 900 to 1000, which looks like hPa. Air pressure is not used, because its only sensor (17) has no readings.
